UNITED STATES
SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION
SCHEDULE 14A
Definitive Additional Materials
ONDAS INC.
SUPPLEMENTAL PROXY MATERIAL
The Annual Meeting will be held on May 28, 2026.
On May 22, 2026, the Chief Executive Officer issued a letter urging stockholders to vote FOR the Authorized Share Increase Proposal, which would approve an amendment to the Company's Articles of Incorporation to increase the number of authorized shares of common stock from 300,000,000 to 600,000,000.
The letter says the additional share authority is important to support the company's strategic plan and future capital needs.
This communication contains forward-looking statements and should be read together with the definitive proxy statement.
